user.title: Name this Adaptive Lighting profile
user.description: Each profile controls one set of lights. You'll be able to add more profiles later for other rooms or scenes.

data_description.name: A short label like "Kitchen" or "Living room".

error.incompatible_version: This entry was created with an older, incompatible version of Adaptive Lighting. Delete the entry and create a new one.

init.title: Adaptive Lighting options
init.description: Tune how this profile adjusts its lights through the day. Hover labels for more detail; the Advanced and Diagnostics sections are collapsed because most households never need to touch them.

data_description.lights: Pick every light that should follow this profile's curve.

daytime_curve.name: Daytime curve
daytime_curve.description: How bright these lights get, and how warm or cool they feel, between sunrise and sunset.

data_description.min_brightness: Brightness at the lowest point of the day (deep night).
data_description.max_brightness: Brightness at the peak of the day (mid-day).
data_description.min_color_temp: The night-time tone — lower numbers are warmer (more orange).
data_description.max_color_temp: The mid-day tone — higher numbers are cooler (more blue).
data_description.prefer_rgb_color: When a light supports both color temperature and RGB, send RGB.

sun_schedule.name: Sun schedule
sun_schedule.description: When morning and evening start. Defaults to your home's sunrise and sunset; point these at Sun2 sensors for civil, nautical, or astronomical twilight.

data_description.sunrise_entity: Any sensor that returns the next sunrise timestamp.
data_description.sunset_entity: Any sensor that returns the next sunset timestamp.

light_control.name: Light control
light_control.description: How this integration talks to your lights when you turn them on by hand or by voice.

data_description.intercept: Apply the curve the moment a light turns on, instead of waiting up to one interval.
data_description.multi_light_intercept: Also intercept calls that target several lights at once. Requires the option above.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Timing knobs. Most households never need to touch these.

data.separate_turn_on_commands: Split brightness and color into separate calls

data_description.interval: How often to recompute and re-apply the curve.
data_description.transition: Fade time for each scheduled curve update.
data_description.initial_transition: Fade time when a light first turns on.
data_description.adapt_delay: Wait this long after a light reports 'on' before applying the curve. Helps lights that report state before they have settled.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Required by lights that cannot accept brightness and color in the same call.
data_description.send_split_delay: Only used when the option above is on.
data_description.skip_redundant_commands: Don't send a command if the light is already at the target state.

data.include_config_in_attributes: Expose all options as switch attributes

data_description.include_config_in_attributes: Useful for templating and dashboards that read the integration's state.

abort.yaml_managed: This Adaptive Lighting profile is managed by YAML. To change its options, edit configuration.yaml.

error.option_error: One of the options has an invalid value.
error.entity_missing: One or more of the selected light entities are not currently registered in Home Assistant.

apply.name: Apply settings
apply.description: Apply this profile's current curve values to its lights immediately, without waiting for the next scheduled update.

entity_id.name: Master switch
entity_id.description: The master switch entity whose profile settings to apply.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Lights to apply the settings to. If empty, applies to all lights the profile controls.

transition.name: Transition time (s)
transition.description: Fade time for this one application.

adapt_color.name: Adapt color
adapt_color.description: Adjust color temperature on supporting lights.

prefer_rgb_color.name: Prefer RGB
prefer_rgb_color.description: Send RGB when the light supports both color temperature and RGB.

turn_on_lights.name: Turn on lights that are off
turn_on_lights.description: If true, also turn on lights that are currently off before applying.

change_switch_settings.name: Change profile settings
change_switch_settings.description: Change one or more of this profile's settings at runtime. The change persists until the next options-flow save or HA restart.

entity_id.name: Master switch
entity_id.description: The master switch entity whose profile to update.

use_defaults.name: Defaults source
use_defaults.description: Where to pull unsupplied values from: 'current' keeps existing values, 'factory' resets to documented defaults, 'configuration' reverts to the profile's configured defaults.

include_config_in_attributes.name: Expose config in attributes
include_config_in_attributes.description: Show all options as attributes on the master switch.

turn_on_lights.name: Turn on lights that are off
turn_on_lights.description: If true, also turn on lights that are currently off before applying.

initial_transition.name: First-on fade (s)
initial_transition.description: Fade time when a light first turns on.

max_brightness.name: Maximum brightness
max_brightness.description: Brightness at the peak of the day.

prefer_rgb_color.name: Prefer RGB
prefer_rgb_color.description: When a light supports both, send RGB.

separate_turn_on_commands.name: Split brightness and color into separate calls

send_split_delay.name: Pause between split calls (ms)
send_split_delay.description: Only used when the option above is on.

sunrise_entity.name: Sunrise entity
sunrise_entity.description: Any sensor that returns the next sunrise timestamp.

sunset_entity.name: Sunset entity
sunset_entity.description: Any sensor that returns the next sunset timestamp.

transition.name: Transition time (s)
transition.description: Fade time for each scheduled curve update.

adapt_delay.name: Delay before adapting (s)
adapt_delay.description: Wait this long after a light reports 'on' before applying.

skip_redundant_commands.name: Skip redundant commands
skip_redundant_commands.description: Don't send a command if the light is already at the target state.

intercept.name: Intercept light.turn_on calls
intercept.description: Apply the curve the moment a light turns on.

multi_light_intercept.name: Intercept multi-light calls
multi_light_intercept.description: Also intercept calls that target several lights at once.

incompatible_version.message: Adaptive Lighting v{current_version} (CDiT fork) is incompatible with the existing config entry (version {entry_version}). Delete the entry from Settings → Devices & Services and create a new one.
